notes: Raw schematic was treated as primary evidence; overlay/crops were used only as visual aids for localization.
Dashed division outlines, equipment-zone boundaries, note boxes, and routing/enclosure graphics are not treated as electrical edges unless a conductor visibly terminates at labeled devices.
Breaker/disconnect symbols are represented by terminal-to-device edges; asserted edges do not imply the internal contact is closed.
The normally open CB-TIE-AB is modeled with BUS-4160-A to CB-TIE-AB and CB-TIE-AB to BUS-4160-B terminal edges only; direct BUS-4160-A to BUS-4160-B continuity is uncertain.
Multiple parallel dashed control conductors in a bundle were collapsed to one undirected control edge between the same visible endpoint devices.
Crossings without junction dots were not treated as connected.
